    5 #===============================================================================
    6 # Superclass that handles moves using a non-existent function code.
    7 # Damaging moves just do damage with no additional effect.
    8 # Status moves always fail.
    9 #===============================================================================
   10 class Battle::Move::Unimplemented < Battle::Move
   11   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
   12     if statusMove?
   13       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
   14       return true
   15     end
   16     return false
   17   end
   18 end

   82 #===============================================================================
   83 # Raise one of user's stats.
   84 #===============================================================================
   85 class Battle::Move::StatUpMove < Battle::Move
   86   attr_reader :statUp
   87 
   88   def canSnatch?; return true; end
   89 
   90   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
   91     return false if damagingMove?
   92     return !user.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(@statUp[0], user, self, true)
   93   end
   94 
   95   def pbEffectGeneral(user)

   97     user.pbRaiseStatStage(@statUp[0], @statUp[1], user)
   98   end

  107 #===============================================================================
  108 # Raise multiple of user's stats.
  109 #===============================================================================
  110 class Battle::Move::MultiStatUpMove < Battle::Move
  111   attr_reader :statUp
  112 
  113   def canSnatch?; return true; end
  114 
  115   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  116     return false if damagingMove?
  117     failed = true
  118     (@statUp.length / 2).times do |i|
  119       next if !user.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(@statUp[i * 2], user, self)
  120       failed = false
  121       break
  122     end
  123     if failed
  124       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s stats won't go any higher!", user.pbThis))
  125       return true
  126     end
  127     return false
  128   end
  129 
  130   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  131     return if damagingMove?
  132     showAnim = true
  133     (@statUp.length / 2).times do |i|
  134       next if !user.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(@statUp[i * 2], user, self)
  135       if user.pbRaiseStatStage(@statUp[i * 2], @statUp[(i * 2) + 1], user, showAnim)
  136         showAnim = false
  137       end
  138     end
  139   end
  140 
  141   def pbAdditionalEffect(user, target)
  142     showAnim = true
  143     (@statUp.length / 2).times do |i|
  144       next if !user.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(@statUp[i * 2], user, self)
  145       if user.pbRaiseStatStage(@statUp[i * 2], @statUp[(i * 2) + 1], user, showAnim)
  146         showAnim = false
  147       end
  148     end
  149   end
  150 end

  195 #===============================================================================
  196 # Lower multiple of target's stats.
  197 #===============================================================================
  198 class Battle::Move::TargetMultiStatDownMove < Battle::Move
  199   attr_reader :statDown
  200 
  201   def canMagicCoat?; return true; end
  202 
  203   def pbFailsAgainstTarget?(user, target, show_message)
  204     return false if damagingMove?
  205     failed = true
  206     (@statDown.length / 2).times do |i|
  207       next if !target.pbCanLowerStatStage?(@statDown[i * 2], user, self)
  208       failed = false
  209       break
  210     end
  211     if failed
  212       # NOTE: It's a bit of a faff to make sure the appropriate failure message
  213       #       is shown here, I know.
  214       canLower = false
  215       if target.hasActiveAbility?(:CONTRARY) && !@battle.moldBreaker
  216         (@statDown.length / 2).times do |i|
  217           next if target.statStageAtMax?(@statDown[i * 2])
  218           canLower = true
  219           break
  220         end
  221         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s stats won't go any higher!", user.pbThis)) if !canLower && show_message
  222       else
  223         (@statDown.length / 2).times do |i|
  224           next if target.statStageAtMin?(@statDown[i * 2])
  225           canLower = true
  226           break
  227         end
  228         @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s stats won't go any lower!", user.pbThis)) if !canLower && show_message
  229       end
  230       if canLower
  231         target.pbCanLowerStatStage?(@statDown[0], user, self, show_message)
  232       end
  233       return true
  234     end
  235     return false
  236   end
  237 
  238   def pbCheckForMirrorArmor(user, target)
  239     if target.hasActiveAbility?(:MIRRORARMOR) && user.index != target.index
  240       failed = true
  241       (@statDown.length / 2).times do |i|
  242         next if target.statStageAtMin?(@statDown[i * 2])
  243         next if !user.pbCanLowerStatStage?(@statDown[i * 2], target, self, false, false, true)
  244         failed = false
  245         break
  246       end
  247       if failed
  248         @battle.pbShowAbilitySplash(target)
  249         if !Battle::Scene::USE_ABILITY_SPLASH
  250           @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s {2} activated!", target.pbThis, target.abilityName))
  251         end
  252         user.pbCanLowerStatStage?(@statDown[0], target, self, true, false, true)   # Show fail message
  253         @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)
  254         return false
  255       end
  256     end
  257     return true
  258   end
  259 
  260   def pbLowerTargetMultipleStats(user, target)
  261     return if !pbCheckForMirrorArmor(user, target)
  262     showAnim = true
  263     showMirrorArmorSplash = true
  264     (@statDown.length / 2).times do |i|
  265       next if !target.pbCanLowerStatStage?(@statDown[i * 2], user, self)
  266       if target.pbLowerStatStage(@statDown[i * 2], @statDown[(i * 2) + 1], user,
  267                                  showAnim, false, (showMirrorArmorSplash) ? 1 : 3)
  268         showAnim = false
  269       end
  270       showMirrorArmorSplash = false
  271     end
  272     @battle.pbHideAbilitySplash(target)   # To hide target's Mirror Armor splash
  273   end
  274 
  275   def pbEffectAgainstTarget(user, target)
  276     pbLowerTargetMultipleStats(user, target) if !damagingMove?
  277   end
  278 
  279   def pbAdditionalEffect(user, target)
  280     pbLowerTargetMultipleStats(user, target) if !target.damageState.substitute
  281   end
  282 end

  287 class Battle::Move::FixedDamageMove < Battle::Move
  288   def pbFixedDamage(user, target); return 1; end
  289 
  290   def pbCalcDamage(user, target, numTargets = 1)

  297 #===============================================================================
  298 # Two turn move.
  299 #===============================================================================
  300 class Battle::Move::TwoTurnMove < Battle::Move
  301   attr_reader :chargingTurn
  302 
  303   def chargingTurnMove?; return true; end
  304 
  305   # user.effects[PBEffects::TwoTurnAttack] is set to the move's ID if this
  306   # method returns true, or nil if false.
  307   # Non-nil means the charging turn. nil means the attacking turn.
  308   def pbIsChargingTurn?(user)
  309     @powerHerb = false
  310     @chargingTurn = false   # Assume damaging turn by default
  311     @damagingTurn = true
  312     # nil at start of charging turn, move's ID at start of damaging turn
  313     if !user.effects[PBEffects::TwoTurnAttack]
  314       @powerHerb = user.hasActiveItem?(:POWERHERB)
  315       @chargingTurn = true
  316       @damagingTurn = @powerHerb
  317     end
  318     return !@damagingTurn   # Deliberately not "return @chargingTurn"
  319   end
  320 
  321   # Stops damage being dealt in the first (charging) turn.
  322   def pbDamagingMove?
  323     return false if !@damagingTurn
  324     return super
  325   end
  326 
  327   # Does the charging part of this move, for when this move only takes one round
  328   # to use.
  329   def pbQuickChargingMove(user, targets)
  330     return if !@chargingTurn || !@damagingTurn   # Move only takes one turn to use
  331     pbChargingTurnMessage(user, targets)
  332     pbShowAnimation(@id, user, targets, 1)   # Charging anim
  333     targets.each { |b| pbChargingTurnEffect(user, b) }
  334     if @powerHerb
  335       # Moves that would make the user semi-invulnerable will hide the user
  336       # after the charging animation, so the "UseItem" animation shouldn't show
  337       # for it
  338       if !["TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSky",
  339            "TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableUnderground",
  340            "TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableUnderwater",
  341            "TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSkyParalyzeTarget",
  342            "TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableRemoveProtections",
  343            "TwoTurnAttackInvulnerableInSkyTargetCannotAct"].include?(@function_code)
  344         @battle.pbCommonAnimation("UseItem", user)
  345       end
  346       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} became fully charged due to its Power Herb!", user.pbThis))
  347       user.pbConsumeItem
  348     end
  349   end
  350 
  351   def pbAccuracyCheck(user, target)
  352     return true if !@damagingTurn
  353     return super
  354   end
  355 
  356   def pbInitialEffect(user, targets, hitNum)
  357     if @damagingTurn
  358       pbAttackingTurnMessage(user, targets)
  359     elsif @chargingTurn
  360       pbChargingTurnMessage(user, targets)
  361     end
  362   end
  363 
  364   def pbChargingTurnMessage(user, targets)
  365     @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} began charging up!", user.pbThis))
  366   end
  367
